latinEntries.meaning: to be on guard, take care

definition_zh: 先于；在……之前；走在前面；位次高于；作为……的前身
definition_en: to come or go before something or someone in time, order, position, or rank
core_image: 一个人先一步走过路口，后面的人还没到
scene: 颁奖典礼之前先有一段简短的致辞。A short speech preceded the award ceremony.
sceneCN: 这里 precede 是「在时间上先于」（第 1 个义项）；句意：颁奖典礼之前先有一段简短致辞。场景要点：先后顺序、前一件先发生、后一件才登场；对应第 1 个义项。

pos.zh: 先于；在……之前；走在前面；位次高于
先行；在前面

derivatives.zh: 先例；在前的
在前的；前面的
前任；前身
优先；位次先后

senses.title: To happen earlier in time
senses.titleCN: 先于：在时间上更早发生
senses.definition: to happen or exist before something else in time
senses.definitionCN: 在时间上比另一事物更早发生或存在
senses.example: A short speech preceded the award ceremony.
senses.exampleCN: 颁奖典礼之前先有一段简短致辞。
senses.why: Latin praecedere is prae 'before' plus cedere 'go'. The first sense is simply going earlier along the timeline.
senses.whyCN: 拉丁 praecedere 是 prae“在前”加 cedere“走”。第一个义项就是沿着时间线走得更早。

senses.title: To come earlier in an order
senses.definition: to come before something else in a sequence, list, or arrangement
senses.definitionCN: 在序列、清单或排列中位于另一事物之前
senses.example: The prefix precedes the root in this word.
senses.exampleCN: 在这个词里，前缀排在词根之前。
senses.why: Time becomes sequence. What goes first on a line is what has preceded the rest, even when no clock is involved.
senses.whyCN: 时间变成了顺序。在一条线上排在最前的，就是先于其余各项的，即使不涉及钟表。

senses.title: To walk in front of
senses.definition: to go in front of someone, especially in a procession or on a route
senses.definitionCN: 走在某人前面，尤指在游行队伍或行进路线上
senses.example: A drummer preceded the bridal party down the street.
senses.exampleCN: 一名鼓手走在迎亲队伍前面，沿街而行。
senses.why: This is the literal picture of the Latin verb: one body moving ahead of another along the same road.
senses.whyCN: 这是拉丁动词最字面的画面：一具身体沿着同一条路走在另一具前面。

senses.title: To outrank or take priority
senses.titleCN: 优先：位次或重要性在前
senses.definition: to be higher in rank, importance, or priority than someone or something
senses.definitionCN: 在级别、重要性或优先次序上高于某人或某物
senses.example: In this court, federal law precedes state law.
senses.exampleCN: 在这个法庭上，联邦法优先于州法。
senses.why: A procession has an order of dignity as well as an order in space. Whoever goes first is served first, so position becomes priority.
senses.whyCN: 队伍不只有空间顺序，还有尊卑顺序。走在前面的人先被招待，于是位置变成了优先权。

senses.title: To go ahead as an introduction
senses.titleCN: 先行开道：把后面的引出来
senses.definition: to come before something as its introduction or preparation
senses.definitionCN: 作为某事物的引子或准备而出现在它之前
senses.example: A period of quiet preceded the storm.
senses.exampleCN: 暴风雨之前有一段平静。
senses.why: What goes first can prepare the way for what follows. The earlier thing is not merely earlier; it ushers the later one in.
senses.whyCN: 走在前面的东西可以为后面的东西铺路。先前之物不只是更早，它还把后来者引了进来。

senses.title: To be the forerunner of
senses.definition: to be an earlier form or ancestor of something that came later
senses.definitionCN: 是后来某事物的较早形态或前身
senses.example: The telegraph preceded the telephone by decades.
senses.exampleCN: 电报比电话早出现了几十年。
senses.why: Objects too can walk in a line through history. The older device stands in front of the newer one, which is its descendant.
senses.whyCN: 物件也能在历史中排队行走。较老的装置站在较新的前面，后者是它的后裔。

senses.title: To preface with words
senses.titleCN: 开场先说：用话在前面铺一层
senses.definition: to say something before the main statement or text
senses.definitionCN: 在主要陈述或正文之前先说一些话
senses.example: He preceded his refusal with a long apology.
senses.exampleCN: 他在拒绝之前先说了很长一段道歉。
senses.why: Speech has an order too. Words placed in front of the main message are doing the walking-ahead.
senses.whyCN: 言语也有顺序。放在主要信息前面的那些话，承担的就是“走在前面”的功能。

senses.title: Literary: to have gone before others
senses.titleCN: 书面：先走一步（指已故的先辈）
senses.definition: in formal or literary use, to have gone before others, especially to have died earlier
senses.definitionCN: 在正式或文学用法中，指先于他人离去，尤指更早去世
senses.example: We honor those who preceded us and built this town.
senses.exampleCN: 我们敬重那些先我们而去、建起这座小镇的人。
senses.why: A procession through life has a front and a back. Those already further along are described as having preceded the living.
senses.whyCN: 穿越一生的队伍有前有后。已经走得更远的人，就被说成先于在世者而行。

intro.en: Precede is a transparent Latin compound: before plus go. Nearly all of its English senses are versions of that one physical picture.
intro.cn: precede 是一个构造透明的拉丁复合词：“在前”加“走”。它在英语里的几乎每个义项，都是这一幅身体画面的变体。

items.en: Prae meant 'before, in front of'. It is the source of the English prefix pre-, and it marks position in space as well as priority in time.
items.cn: prae 意为“在前、在……之前”。它是英语前缀 pre- 的来源，既标记空间位置，也标记时间上的优先。

items.en: Cedere meant 'to go, to yield, to withdraw'. English gets cede, accede, exceed, proceed, and succeed from this verb.
items.cn: cedere 意为“走、让、退”。英语的 cede、accede、exceed、proceed、succeed 都出自这个动词。

items.en: Praecedere meant 'to go before, to precede'. It described both people walking ahead and events coming earlier.
items.cn: praecedere 意为“走在前面、先于”。它既描述人走在前头，也描述事件更早发生。

items.en: Old French took the verb as preceder, keeping the sense of going or coming before.
items.cn: 古法语把这个动词接作 preceder，保留“走在前面、先来”的意思。

items.en: English precede is recorded in the 15th century. The legal noun precedent and the noun precedence grow from the same root.
items.cn: 英语 precede 记录于 15 世纪。法律名词 precedent 与名词 precedence 都从同一个词根长出。

items.en: Modern usage extends the image to ranks, arguments, inventions, and even the dead: whatever stands earlier in a line has preceded what stands later.
items.cn: 现代用法把这幅画面扩展到等级、论证、发明，甚至逝者：凡在一条线上站得更早的，就先于站得更晚的。

note.en: The first group shares the Latin verb for going. The second group collects words for coming before in time, order, and rank.
note.cn: 第一组共享拉丁语表示“走”的动词。第二组收表示“在时间、顺序、等级上在前”的词。

entries.definition: to go forward or continue. Pro- 'forward' plus cedere 'go', so it moves ahead rather than before.
entries.definitionCN: 前进或继续进行。pro-“向前”加 cedere“走”，所以它是向前走，而非走在前面。

entries.definition: an earlier case used as a rule for later ones. It is the noun of precede in legal usage.
entries.definitionCN: 被用作后来案例规则的先前判例。它是 precede 在法律用法中的名词。

entries.definition: the person who held a post before another. From Latin prae- plus decedere 'to go away', literally one who went before.
entries.definitionCN: 在某人之前担任某职位的人。来自拉丁 prae- 加 decedere“离开”，字面即“先走的人”。

entries.definition: the right to go or be treated first. It is the abstract noun of precede.
entries.definitionCN: 先行或被优先对待的权利。它是 precede 的抽象名词。

entries.definition: to exist or happen before something in date. Predate is narrower, used only of time.
entries.definitionCN: 在日期上早于某事物。predate 更窄，只用于时间。

entries.definition: to be earlier than, or to put an earlier date on. Antedate is formal and often about documents.
entries.definitionCN: 早于，或在文件上写较早的日期。antedate 较正式，常用于文件。

entries.definition: to go in front and show the way. Lead implies guiding; precede only states the order.
entries.definitionCN: 走在前面并带路。lead 含引导之意；precede 只陈述先后顺序。

entries.definition: to have a higher rank than someone. Outrank matches sense 04 exactly and is used of people and offices.
entries.definitionCN: 级别高于某人。outrank 精确对应第 4 义项，多用于人与职位。

entries.definition: to go before as a sign or precursor. Forerun is literary and rare; its noun forerunner is common.
entries.definitionCN: 作为征兆或先驱先行。forerun 带文学色彩且少见；其名词 forerunner 更常用。

normalIntro.en: Five hooks: the walker ahead, the prefix before the root, the court that hears federal law first, the older machine, and the ancestors.
normalIntro.cn: 五个抓手：走在前面的人、词根前的前缀、先审联邦法的法庭、更老的机器、先辈。

normal.en: Pre- means before, cede means go. Precede is literally before-go.
normal.cn: pre- 是“在前”，cede 是“走”。precede 字面就是“先走”。

normal.en: In the word unhappy, un- precedes happy: it walks in front of the root.
normal.cn: 在 unhappy 这个词里，un- 走在 happy 前面，就是 precede 词根。

normal.en: Take precedence: whoever walks first gets served first.
normal.cn: take precedence：谁走在前面，谁先被招待。

normal.en: The telegraph preceded the telephone; the older machine stands in front of the newer one in history's queue.
normal.cn: 电报先于电话；在历史的队伍里，更老的机器站在更新的前面。

normal.en: Those who preceded us are the ones already further up the road.
normal.cn: 先我们而去的人，就是已经在路上走得更远的那些。

abstract.en: Order is not a thing in the world but a line we draw; precede is the word for standing on the earlier side of that line.
abstract.cn: 顺序不是世界里的物件，而是我们画的线；precede 就是在一条线较早一侧站着的说法。

abstract.en: Priority borrows its grammar from walking: we say law comes first as if laws had legs.
abstract.cn: 优先权借用了行走的语法：我们说法律“在先”，仿佛法律长了腿。

abstract.en: Every forerunner is only recognized as one after the thing it preceded has arrived.
abstract.cn: 每一个前身，都只有在它所先行的那件事到来之后，才被认出来是前身。

examples.en: The years preceding the war were marked by rapid industrial growth.
examples.cn: 战前那些年以快速的工业增长为标志。

examples.en: In the protocol, the chair's remarks precede the vote.
examples.cn: 按议程，主席发言在投票之前。

examples.en: Several small tremors preceded the main earthquake.
examples.cn: 主震之前发生了数次小震动。

dict_mnemonic.text: “普瑞西德”——普瑞先一步西德而行，就是 precede（先于、走在前面）

root: 拉丁语 praecedere＝prae“在前”+ cedere“走” → 古法语 preceder → 英语 precede（15 世纪）；与 proceed、precedent、predecessor、cede 同根。

sensesIntro.en: One physical image serves everything: something moves ahead of something else on the same line. Time, sequence, space, rank, introduction, ancestry, and even death are all lines along which one item can stand before another.
sensesIntro.cn: 一幅身体画面统摄全部义项：某物在同一条线上走在另一物前面。时间、顺序、空间、等级、引子、前身，甚至死亡，都是可以让一个项目站在另一个之前的线。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: one walker a few steps ahead of another on the same road.
core.cn: 核心意象：同一条路上，一个行者比另一个领先几步。

branches.en: TIME AND SEQUENCE: earlier on the timeline or in the list.
branches.cn: 时间与顺序：在时间线上或清单里更早。

branches.en: SPACE: a body moving in front along a route.
branches.cn: 空间：一具身体沿路线走在前面。

branches.en: RANK: position turned into priority and precedence.
branches.cn: 等级：位置变成优先权与位次。

branches.en: INTRODUCTION: what goes first to prepare or frame what follows.
branches.cn: 引子：先走一步，为后面的东西铺路或定框。

branches.en: LINEAGE: the earlier device and the people already further along.
branches.cn: 谱系：更早的器物，以及已经走得更远的人。

intro.en: Precede is built from a prefix of position and a verb of motion. The same two pieces, with other prefixes, produce much of the vocabulary of going and yielding.
intro.cn: precede 由一个表位置的前缀和一个表运动的动词构成。同样两个构件配上别的前缀，产出了大量表示“行走与让渡”的词汇。

latinIntro.en: Latin praecedere passed into French and English; its participle and noun forms supplied precedent, precedence, and predecessor.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁 praecedere 传入法语与英语；它的分词与名词形式提供了 precedent、precedence、predecessor。

items.meaningCN: 表示施动者或性质的后缀
表示状态或性质的名词后缀
